checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Complete original picture centred with navy padding, no cropping/distortion
must.why: The picture is cropped to a narrow window, squeezed, with the robot's left side cut and the rest of the scene lost; the original widescreen image is not shown whole.

must.item: Robot, plant, background and animation match previous clip
must.why: Regenerated: the robot design differs, the background is mostly lost, and the motion is new.
The text reads 'mall steps' with the S cut off in every frame.

must.item: Preserves 8s duration, action order and timing
must.why: It is 8 s long, but the action differs from the original clip.
Audio cannot be judged from still frames.

faults.what: The title is cut to 'mall steps' in all frames, with the S missing.
The original picture is cropped and squeezed into a small window with a soft edge, and the side scenery is lost. The result does not show the whole original picture.
The robot is warped and redesigned, with a lumpy head and a stray object at its feet. It drifts left and is partly cut off at the frame edge.
The picture takes up only a small part of the frame, so large navy areas remain.

summary: The 9:16 video came out, but the title reads "mall steps", the original scene is cropped and warped, and the robot is redrawn, so it fails the brief.
